title: Checkpoint Counts
description: Counts of recordings at one processing checkpoint. While a run reports live, passed + failed + skipped <= total; once reconciled, passed + failed + skipped = total. Every checkpoint of one run has the same total (a recording that failed or was skipped earlier counts as skipped later). The writer enforces these invariants; the schema cannot. nemar-cli's live progress object reuses this shape.

failed.description: Recordings that failed at this checkpoint.

skipped.description: Recordings skipped at this checkpoint, including those that failed or were skipped at an earlier one.
